_about: Post-processing settings of the Scapes style: the one place for their numbers. They are the settings object of core/image/adjust.js (brightness: levels 0..255 added to luma; saturation: multiplier of the colour difference from luma; sharpen: unsharp mask on luma, amount and Gaussian radius in px). neutral = no change. start = the starting settings per generation model (OpenRouter model id, "codex-cli", or "agent" for an image an agent made with its own tool and handed in with `ccf.mjs card import`, model unknown; a name instead of an object refers to another entry of this file, e.g. "neutral"), chosen on the trial cards: the measures they give and why are in RENDERING.md «Резкость при обработке: цель и начальные настройки» and COLOUR.md «5. Насыщенность и яркость после генерации». sharpen_amount_max = the upper bound of sharpening on the trial cards (RENDERING.md, same section). Re-check on new generations with checks/adjust-trial.mjs. Per-card search (core/card/tune.js, run by the card loop after each generation): starts from `start`, measures the checks `tune_checks` (the aims of COLOUR.md «5. Насыщенность и яркость после генерации» → «Цель» and RENDERING.md «Резкость при обработке» → «Цель»; COLOUR.15 applies only at night or dusk, COLOUR.8 only with a hero outline confirmed by eye) against the bible's adjustment target where thresholds.json gives one, else the norm; and searches saturation × brightness (the COLOUR measures), then the sharpening amount (the RENDERING measures) within `bounds` (sharpening up to sharpen_amount_max) for the setting inside the aims with the smallest change. The bounds of saturation (0.8–1.45; the bible tried up to 1.45) and brightness (±20 levels), and the steps, are not bible numbers: chosen by the helper on the trial cards (2026-10-30), not decided by the author.
